features.name: Spellcasting
features.desc: You learn and cast spells from the Wizard spell list, using Intelligence (one-third caster).

features.name: Weapon Bond
features.desc: Through a ritual, you bond with up to two weapons; you can summon a bonded weapon to your hand as a Bonus Action.

features.name: War Magic
features.desc: When you take the Attack action, you can replace one of the attacks with casting a cantrip.

features.name: Eldritch Strike
features.desc: When you hit a creature with a weapon, it has Disadvantage on its next saving throw against your spell before the end of your next turn.

features.name: Arcane Charge
features.desc: When you use Action Surge, you can teleport up to 30 feet before or after the action.

features.name: Improved War Magic
features.desc: When you take the Attack action, you can replace two of the attacks with casting a level 1 or 2 spell.
